result.title: Benchmarking VLM Medical Hallucination across 5 Modalities
result.summary: Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) within the medical domain remain a difficult and not well-understood problem, and it is still unclear where these models break down. Although several benchmarks targeting medical hallucination have been introduced, they often lack broad coverage across different medical imaging modalities. We introduce Multi-Med, a medical hallucination benchmark containing 1,000 image-question pairs spanning five distinct modalities. Using this benchmark, we perform an in-depth experimental study of 10 widely used VLMs across five modalities and four question categories. Our findings indicate that model performance differs substantially depending on the imaging modality and question type, and that the differences among the best-performing models are not statistically significant.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 Multi-Med 医学幻觉基准，含 1,000 个图像—问题对，覆盖五种影像模态和四类问题，并比较 10 个 VLM 的幻觉表现与模态、问题类型差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 该基准提供多模态幻觉诊断与失败分析，可供核查模型是否保留并实际使用视觉细节、错误是否随模态和问题类型变化；但未触及 latent 状态或推理机制，需读原文确认问题设计能否区分视觉旁路与证据筛选失败。
